name: Rollo Armstrong
notes: The Faithless-side downtempo/house producer working on adult pop: 88–100 straight with 16th hats and the backbeat on 2&4. The harmonic device is documented and is the same one his flagship artist carries — minor verses resolving to the **relative major** for the chorus and bridge, "i–VI–III–VII becoming I–V–vi–IV without changing the note pool" — so both cycles are authored at equal weight. Where this model parts from that artist entry is the kit's two-stage construction, which his entry states and hers does not: "live drums layered **under the programming on the choruses only**", so the fill schedule is tight where hers is wide, the ghost runs busier, and the humanize carries a live velocity spread. The other deltas are quoted: "kick on 1 and the '&' of 3", "soft snare/clap on the backbeat" with the kit "sitting low in the mix" (a soft tier and a −6 dB perc offset), and "filtered 16th hats, vinyl noise and tambourine as texture". The bass is stated as **programming** rather than playing — "a rounded sub on roots with long durations and no slides; a live bass appears for the chorus lift" — which is `mirror_kick` at 0.94 with `glideProb` 0. "A piano/strings outro is his standard tail", which is the long outro and the sustained-pad counter. ⚠ `confidence` is medium because the research rates it high-medium. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are every drum probability and `bpm.mode` 92. ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than the held `reese_sustain` the research describes** — *“bass programming rather than played bass on most tracks — a rounded sub on roots with long durations and no slides; a live bass appears for the chorus lift.”* — and that is a limit of the engine rather than a reading of the record. `generators::phrase_spans` re-articulates a held span only when it runs longer than two bars, so over the four-bar clip `reese_sustain` writes at most four notes and cannot reach the 500-bassline floor `engine/tests/bass.rs` holds every model to. `mobb-deep`, `dmx` and `capone-n-noreaga` carry the same substitution for the same reason; `followRootsProb` stays where it was so the line still reads as roots under the chord.
